title: Line position and local repetition
summary: Measure first/last-token length and repeated adjacent-token rates by locus type.
assumptions: Locus-to-line mapping and exclusions are explicit.
controls: Within-line shuffles preserving token multiset; uncertainty sensitivity; source checks.
limitations: Discarded uncertain words can create apparent adjacency; layout conventions can mimic grammar.
cost: CPU-scale initial protocol or small manual evidence audit; declare exact budget before expanding.
